bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, a 27-year-old man died and his colleague became critical after falling into a septic tank from toxic fumes while clearing drainage.
Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated the Rs 3,108 crore Chennai ring main drinking water project to ensure steady water supply to expanding metropolitan areas.
Two youngsters were arrested in Besant Nagar for attacking a security guard with a knife after he questioned harassment towards his daughter.
The Tamil Nadu State Wetlands Authority submitted an interim buffer zone of 316.76 acres for the Pallikaranai Ramsar wetland covering 36 survey numbers.
The Velachery Residents Welfare Association hosted a thanksgiving lunch to recognize the contribution of sanitation workers in maintaining neighbourhood cleanliness.
Avadi police arrested friends who cheated individuals of Rs 6 crore by falsely promising online trading training.
A lawyer and a prisoner were booked at Puzhal Central Prison after authorities found ganja concealed inside a pen refill.
Korattur lake is shrinking and polluted by sewage and industrial waste, leading residents to demand sanctuary status for its bird species.
Adani Enterprises and Jabil signed a pact to form a 50:50 joint venture in India for manufacturing AI and data centre hardware.
A retired scientist and former Ministry director lost Rs 1.25 crore in a digital arrest scam, leading to eleven arrests.
NITI Aayog and Deloitte India launched an evaluation framework asking states to link data centre approvals to verified electricity and water availability.
The DMK connected actor-turned-politician Vijay's hand gesture to the RSS salute, reviving the BJP B-team political charge.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inspected the Okkiyam Maduvu canal area in Sholinganallur ahead of the monsoon season.
Chief Minister Vijay inquired with officials about a modern technology-based plan to manage drinking water distribution more efficiently in Chennai.
